name: predictor-mundial-2026
description: Predictor Mundial FIFA 2026 — Motor Poisson-Dixon-Coles + Gemini AI

scripts.test:engine: node -e "const E=require('./engine.js');const d=require('./data.json');const e=new E(d);const r=e.predictMatch('Argentina','Francia');console.log('Argentina vs Francia:',r.winA+'%','draw:'+r.draw+'%','Francia:'+r.winB+'%','Score:',r.mostLikelyScore);"
scripts.build: echo 'No build step required — static HTML/JS + Vercel Serverless Functions' && npm run test:engine
